content: {"phoneNote":"The license-plate phone button is a clever, memorable touch for a car repair shop, though the header wastes vertical space by wrapping 'Navodila za pot' onto a second line and repeating it twice more in the first scroll.","desktopNote":"The bold typography and license-plate motif feel genuinely tailored to the trade, but single-column sections like 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' and 'Kako poteka delo' leave the right half of the screen completely empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Remove the redundant 'Navodila za pot' link beneath the hero phone number, as it already appears in the top bar and immediately below in the blue address band.","On phone, tighten the header so the brand name and menu sit cleanly on one row without a second sparse row just for 'Navodila za pot'.","On desktop, use a two-column layout for the 'Vlečemo po vsej Savinjski regiji' and 'Kako poteka delo' sections to balance the heavy left-aligned headlines and eliminate the dead space on the right."],"blockers":[]}
